tasks.question: How does total release count across the three genres relate to the year, from 2015 to 2018? (A) It decreases over the four years (B) It increases over the four years (C) There is no consistent relationship. Answer with just the letter.
How did total release count change from 2016 to 2017? (A) It rose (B) It fell sharply, by more than 25% (C) It fell slightly, by less than 10%. Answer with just the letter.
Which year had the lowest total release count? (A) 2015 (B) 2017 (C) 2018. Answer with just the letter.
Which genre had the highest release count in 2018? (A) Free to Play (B) Unknown (C) Simulation. Answer with just the letter.
Did any genre's release count fall from one year to the next? (A) Yes (B) No. Answer with just the letter.
How many years had higher total release count than the year before them? (A) 1 (B) 2 (C) 3. Answer with just the letter.
Approximately how much did total release count change from 2015 to 2018? (A) About -10% (B) About +310% (C) About +118%. Answer with just the letter.
Which genre had the largest release count drop from 2016 to 2017? (A) Simulation (B) Free to Play (C) No genre dropped. Answer with just the letter.
Which ordering correctly ranks the years from highest to lowest total release count? (A) 2018, 2016, 2017, 2015 (B) 2016, 2015, 2018, 2017 (C) 2018, 2017, 2016, 2015. Answer with just the letter.
Which year breaks the overall trend in total release count? (A) 2017 (B) 2016 (C) None; every year follows the trend. Answer with just the letter.
